Bill.BriefDescription: Studying the telecommunications and information industries.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to studying the telecommunications and informationindustries; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The utilities and transportation commissionshall conduct a comprehensive analysis of the structure of the state'stelecommunications and information industries. The study shalladdress, among other things, the state of competition amongtelecommunications providers and services; consumer protections;interconnection rights and obligations, including carriertocarrierservice quality; public safety; number administration and portability;and universal service. The study shall set forth recommendations forlegislative and regulatory measures to improve telecommunicationsservices, promote investment in innovative technologies and services,and provide appropriate protections for consumers and the public. Thecommission shall consult, where appropriate, with other agencies,including the department of information services, the department ofcommunity, trade, and economic development, the department of revenue,and the military department, as well as telecommunications service p. 1 SSB 5628providers and other stakeholders. The commission shall submit itsstudy to the legislature by December 1, 2009.
